integrity: Two independent finite-field checkers on q=2,3,4,5 corroborate a symbolic all-field proof; no independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Only the idempotent subfamily of weight-minus-one Rota–Baxter maps on T2; no nonreduced scheme or larger matrix size. An–Bai 2007 covers all characteristic-zero operator normal forms. Novelty of arithmetic/orbit refinement is provisional.
title: Uniform finite-field census and twenty automorphism orbits of idempotent Rota–Baxter splittings on triangular matrices
